_about: Matches the editor should always decide: grade forced to unsure, with extra DOE entries offered (add); or entries never to link (skip). Read by match.py.

ciricthen.note: BT link cyric-tún led to cyric-tūn; ciricþen is a church servant

del.note: = de + li: French, not Old English

d-y-nge.note: Dung (noun): dung or dyncge, not the verb dyngan

eowende.note: Zeugungsgliede: the noun (DOE 'owend', garbled), not the verb ēowan

aedel.note: adlig, edel (noble): æþele, not ēþel (homeland); its Bosworth-Toller links include éðel

fylgean.note: fylgan (DOE has it separately), not folgian

gebige.note: beuge (verb): ge·bīgan, not the noun ge·byge

gebycgean.note: buy: ge·bicgan; its Bosworth-Toller link led to ge·bīgan
